name: @playform/client-dsh-workspace-live
description: The workspace family's live client: the client half of the workspace live view (Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/LIVE.md). The role: the presentation, stable-until-event - the live view does NOT re-render continuously; it stays stable until a workspace event surfaces a change, and it presents at the END of the invisible flow (... -> the audit lines -> the live view presents). It presents the workspace's REPRESENTATIONS of the Entity/Presentation/Interaction model, never a running OS process (the OS execution axis stays orthogonal). Self-contained PoC: the sibling workspace services (workspaceGraph, workspaceObserve, the workspace events) are declared locally in Source/Interface/Siblings.ts from the W1 frozen contract (Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/WAVE-1-BRIEF.md sections 4-5) - no runtime import of sibling packages exists yet; the end-phase wires the real imports. The client half provides the workspaceLive service (snapshot/subscribe) and mounts the conversation.view tab workspace-live, rendering the workspace's representations from the subscribed event stream.
